### Compatibility

Mirrors renderOwnerBadge over renderBadgePrimitive: label/text/owner/ownerType/value precedence, status/state metadata, owner variant and Owner fallback. ownerIdField lowers to owner and ownerTypeField to ownerType. The badge is noninteractive; no ownership change is implied.
